info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides the current status of streaming subscriptions, enabling users to monitor their subscription health and operational state. By querying the endpoint, consumers can retrieve detailed information about active subscriptions, including their status, which is essential for maintaining seamless streaming experiences. Typical users include developers and system administrators seeking to ensure their applications are performing optimally. Use cases might involve regular status checks or monitoring for troubleshooting purposes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of subscriptions for a given user or account. It is useful for monitoring active subscriptions and understanding their current state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of subscriptions. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request to obtain accurate information based on user-specific or system-wide subscription details.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation on subscriptions status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.title: Subscription Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier associated with the subscription request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the subscription operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.description: This schema represents the response returned for a subscription status retrieval request.
